(function () {
var C = $262.createRealm().global.$262.evalScript(
  '0, class extends Object {' +
  '  constructor() {' +
  '    return null;' +
  '  }' +
  '}'
);

assert.throws(TypeError, function() {
  new C();
});
})();


console.log("DS19 derived-return complete");
